reconcile.note: Clarke attributes Korah's appearance among Eliphaz's descendants to a scribal interpolation missing from the Samaritan Pentateuch, leaving him solely a son of Esau.

sides.snippet: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek: these are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz
sides.verseText: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek: these are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.

sides.snippet: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau's wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah
sides.verseText: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau's wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah: these are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.
